---
title: "Body mass index across smoking-status groups (NHANES 2017-2018)"
output: html_document
---

This example implements the BMI analysis described in Figure 4 of the
manuscript. The original analysis script, saved similarity structures and
exact SS calculation settings are not yet available in this repository.
The code below reconstructs the cohort from public NHANES files and uses
explicit provisional analysis settings. Check the cohort and settings
against the authors' original analysis before treating the output as a
reproduction of Figure 4.

## Data preparation

The CDC files are DEMO_J (age), BMX_J (body measures) and SMQ_J
(cigarette use). Smoking status is defined according to the responses to
SMQ020 and SMQ040. This is an unweighted analysis of the observed sample
to match the ordinary Welch tests described in the manuscript; it is
not a survey-weighted estimate for the US population.

```{r}
library(similaritystructure)
# install.packages("haven")
library(haven)

base_url <- "https://wwwn.cdc.gov/Nchs/Data/Nhanes/Public/2017/DataFiles/"

# Download each public data file once to a temporary directory.
read_nhanes <- function(name) {
  file <- tempfile(fileext = ".XPT")
  on.exit(unlink(file))
  download.file(paste0(base_url, name, ".XPT"), file,
                mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
  as.data.frame(haven::read_xpt(file))
}

demo <- read_nhanes("DEMO_J")[, c("SEQN", "RIDAGEYR")]
bmx  <- read_nhanes("BMX_J")[, c("SEQN", "BMXBMI")]
smq  <- read_nhanes("SMQ_J")[, c("SEQN", "SMQ020", "SMQ040")]

dat <- merge(merge(demo, bmx, by = "SEQN"), smq, by = "SEQN")
dat <- dat[!is.na(dat$RIDAGEYR) & dat$RIDAGEYR >= 20 &
             is.finite(dat$BMXBMI), ]
dat$Smoking <- NA_character_
dat$Smoking[which(dat$SMQ020 == 2)] <- "Never"
dat$Smoking[which(dat$SMQ020 == 1 & dat$SMQ040 == 3)] <- "Former"
dat$Smoking[which(dat$SMQ020 == 1 & dat$SMQ040 %in% c(1, 2))] <- "Current"
dat <- dat[!is.na(dat$Smoking), ]
dat$Smoking <- factor(dat$Smoking, levels = c("Never", "Former", "Current"))

groups <- split(dat$BMXBMI, dat$Smoking)
observed <- data.frame(Group = names(groups), N = lengths(groups),
                       Mean = vapply(groups, mean, numeric(1)))
observed
# Cohort reported in the manuscript: verify before continuing.
expected <- c(Never = 3234L, Former = 1329L, Current = 1006L)
if (!all(lengths(groups) == expected)) {
  warning("Cohort counts differ from the manuscript: check original exclusions.")
}
```

## Pairwise Welch tests and Cohen's d

```{r}
pairs <- list("F-C" = c("Former", "Current"),
              "F-N" = c("Former", "Never"),
              "N-C" = c("Never", "Current"))

contrasts <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(pairs), function(nm) {
  a <- groups[[pairs[[nm]][1]]]
  b <- groups[[pairs[[nm]][2]]]
  pooled_sd <- sqrt(((length(a)-1)*var(a) + (length(b)-1)*var(b)) /
                      (length(a)+length(b)-2))
  data.frame(Comparison = nm, Mean_diff = mean(a)-mean(b),
             Cohen_d = (mean(a)-mean(b))/pooled_sd,
             p = t.test(a, b)$p.value)
}))
contrasts$p_Holm <- p.adjust(contrasts$p, method = "holm")
contrasts
```

## Similarity structures and pS

The following calculation settings are provisional: the original N_fin
values, seed and replacement setting are not reported in the draft.
The limits below do not exceed the smaller original group. In particular,
the smallest BMI effect may have a non-negligible tail at that limit;
inspect the fit and do not interpret a truncated smooth result as an
infinite-support estimate.

```{r}
N_fin <- vapply(pairs, function(p) min(lengths(groups[p])), integer(1))
q <- 60L
K <- 300L
alpha <- 0.05
seed <- 12345L

ss <- lapply(seq_along(pairs), function(i) {
  p <- pairs[[i]]
  similarity_structure(groups[[p[1]]], groups[[p[2]]],
    N_init = 2, N_fin = N_fin[i], num_N = q, num_repet = K,
    test = "t-test", replace = TRUE, alpha = alpha,
    seed = seed + i, plotting = TRUE, title_plot = names(pairs)[i])
})
names(ss) <- names(pairs)

ns <- data.frame(Comparison = names(ss),
  Smooth = vapply(ss, function(x) x$simil_struct_Ns$smooth$Ns_smooth, numeric(1)),
  Fitting = vapply(ss, function(x) {
    f <- x$simil_struct_Ns$fitting
    if (is.null(f)) NA_real_ else f$Ns_fitting
  }, numeric(1)))
ns

comparisons <- combn(names(ss), 2, simplify = FALSE)
ps <- do.call(rbind, lapply(comparisons, function(p) {
  a <- ss[[p[1]]]$simil_struct_Ns
  b <- ss[[p[2]]]$simil_struct_Ns
  data.frame(Comparison = paste(p, collapse = " vs "),
    ps_smooth = prob_effect(smooth_A = a$smooth, smooth_B = b$smooth),
    ps_fit = if (is.null(a$fitting) || is.null(b$fitting)) NA_real_ else
      prob_effect(fitting_A = a$fitting, fitting_B = b$fitting))
}))
ps
```

CDC documentation: [DEMO_J](https://wwwn.cdc.gov/Nchs/Data/Nhanes/Public/2017/DataFiles/DEMO_J.htm),
[BMX_J](https://wwwn.cdc.gov/Nchs/Data/Nhanes/Public/2017/DataFiles/BMX_J.htm),
[SMQ_J](https://wwwn.cdc.gov/Nchs/Data/Nhanes/Public/2017/DataFiles/SMQ_J.htm).
